event_summary.short: Police responding to an eviction in Euclid, Ohio, on November 9, 2003, were met with gunfire from resident Chad McGraw. Officer Lindsay was trapped on the porch before being rescued. McGraw was found with a self-inflicted gunshot wound and later died at the hospital.
